title: Franklin Mint HO Southern Crescent Limited 1396 4-6-2 Locomotive & Tender 1989
descriptionText:
Franklin Mint Precision Models HO scale (1:87) Southern Railway "Crescent Limited" 4-6-2 Pacific steam locomotive AND its matching tender, road number 1396 - sold together as a set.
LOCOMOTIVE: Die-cast body in the Crescent's green and white livery with gold striping, crescent-moon heralds on the cab and cylinders, brass-look piping and handrails, and an American Locomotive Company builder's plate on the smokebox. Marked "(c) 1989 FMPM" on the underside. About 7 inches long. Paint and decals are bright with no chips found; light dust on the boiler top and smokebox and normal light wear to the running gear. Detail parts, pilot and rear drawbar are all present.
TENDER: Die-cast in Southern's dark green with gold "SOUTHERN" and "CRESCENT LIMITED" lettering and gold striping, molded coal load, ladder and coupler detail. Marked "CRESCENT LIMITED (c)1989 FMPM" on the underside. Paint and lettering bright with no chips noted.
Pre-owned. No display base, box or paperwork. Not test-run on track - sold as a display set. Please review all photos - they are of the actual locomotive and tender you will receive. Ships well packed.
